title: Kroger.VIP Create
description: A Create modpack for Kroger Employees
body:
# Kroger Create

**Kroger Create** is a lightweight, performance-focused factory and exploration modpack built for our *Kroger Discord community*.  
It combines **[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric)**, **[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)**, and a tuned Fabric optimization stack to deliver **massive automation** and **smooth performance**.

---

## 🏭 Core Gameplay Mods
- **[Create Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric)** `6.0.8+build.1734`  
  Build mechanical contraptions, transport systems, and industrial factories.  
- **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** `0.92.6`  
  The essential library mod that provides the foundation for most Fabric mods.  
- **[Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port-fabric)** `v8.0.2`  
  Enables cross-mod configuration support on Fabric.  
- **[Just Enough Items (JEI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)** `15.2.0.118`  
  Recipe lookup and crafting helper for modded content.  
- **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)** `6.0.1`  
  Memory optimization and reduced RAM footprint for Create builds.  

---

## 🌄 Visuals & Rendering
- **[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)** `2.3.6-b`  
  Adds LOD terrain rendering for extreme view distances and low-lag megabases.  
- **[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)** `1.7.6`  
  Modern shader loader compatible with Sodium and Complementary.  
- **[Complementary Reimagined r5.6.1](https://github.com/ComplementaryDevelopment/ComplementaryReimagined)** by *Emin GT / Complementary Development*  
(https://github.com/ComplementaryDevelopment/ComplementaryReimagined)  
- **[Colorwheel](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorwheel)** `1.1.1`  
  Real-time shader color adjustment tool for Iris.  
- **[Colorwheel Patcher](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorwheel-patcher)** `1.0.3`  
  Adds compatibility between Iris and advanced shader color profiles.  

---

## ⚙️ Performance & Optimization
- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)** `mc1.20.1-0.513` – FPS and renderer overhaul  
- **[Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium)** `1.0.36` – Enables Fabric Renderer API with Sodium  
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)** `mc1.20.1-0.11.3` – Optimizes AI and block updates  
- **[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)** `5.24.4` – Faster loads + reduced memory use  

---

## 🧭 Utility & World Enhancements
- **[BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap)** `5.3` – Generates a live 3D web map of your world  
- **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)** `1.9.3` – Stops rendering hidden entities  
- **[Xaero’s Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)** `25.2.10` – Customizable minimap with waypoints  
- **[Xaero’s World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)** `1.39.12` – Full-screen map with dimension support  

---

## 🧰 Recommended Setup
- **Minecraft:** `1.20.1 (Fabric)`  
- **Java:** `17+`  
- **RAM:** `8 GB minimum` (12 GB recommended for Distant Horizons + Create)
